<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Pilot''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍パイロット</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊位置カード上での戦闘力は０である。ただし、彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-180o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍最精鋭のパイロット。忠誠心と勇猛さに優れる。人数において敵を圧倒し、戦場の場数を踏むことで鍛え上げられていく。密封型の耐Ｇフライトスーツに身を包む。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Pilot.

'''Card text:''' * Power is 0 at a site. A starship he pilots is power +2.

'''Lore:''' Among the Empire's finest pilots. Loyal and fierce. They overwhelm opponents with numbers and are trained under combat conditions. They wear sealed high-G flight suits.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Pilot]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
